title: [2.8] Setup Wizard fails to import configuration
symptom: When using the Setup Wizard after a fresh install of AndroidAPS 2.8, pressing the button to import settings does nothing. The issue was reported by multiple users.
cause: The issue is likely due to storage permission not being applied until the app is restarted or the activity is switched.
fix: Restart AndroidAPS or switch between screens to apply storage permission, then the import should work. Alternatively, use the maintenance dialogue to import settings.
evidence_quote: on some phones it's necessary to restart aaps to apply storage permission
